question: How should the essential form of the fire-pit be understood in relation to primordial nature?
premises: The form of the fire-pit is to be known.
Primordial nature has a supreme body.
The fire-pit is identified with that body.
inference: One should know the form of the fire-pit as the supreme body of primordial nature.
plain_english: One should know the form of the fire-pit to be the supreme body of primordial nature.
